dem.title_zh: 地形 · Copernicus GLO-30 地表模型
dem.vertical_reference: project DSM source values (GLO-30 source is orthometric, EGM2008); not a certified survey height or river stage
dem.display_resampling: bilinear to EPSG:4326 point node lattice. This is the web display surface, not a new routing computation.
dem.interpretation_zh: 是地表模型，可能含植被和建筑；仅供三维定位和展示，不能读取涵洞断面或实测水位。

imagery.reprojection: nearest neighbour (UTM 50N 10 m native TCI to 4326 grid, nominal 10 m around the AOI); north-up, image edges on bounds. No interpolation to fill holes.
imagery.scl_counts_note: SCL is native 20 m; counts are display resampling, NOT native independent pixels or an analytical water mask.
imagery.interpretation_zh: 真彩观测背景，保留云、阴影、积雪；透明仅表示缺测。不是水面判别结果，不能用作覆盖率统计。
imagery.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data; distributed as COG via Element 84 Earth Search.
imagery.display_note_zh: 局部以柔化金色示意填补，不作影像判读。

coverage_note_zh: 共同覆盖西北坡、西长湖、G332 检查段、呼吉尔诺尔主湖和近邻伊敏河剖面端。日期属于卫星底图，不能替代专题图层的观测月份。
